value: ICE Brent: inefficient on average at sampling under 10 minutes; efficiency at lower frequencies (up to 2 hours) improves over 2006-2021; costs not included
detail: Smith-Meyer, Haugom and Ewald (2025), International Review of Financial Analysis 105:104424 (open access). Efficiency measure (AMIM, autocorrelation-based), not a trading test; authors state transaction costs not included. Same asset (crude), another benchmark and venue.
quote: At very high sampling frequencies (less than 10 min), the market is on average inefficient. For lower sampling frequencies, efficiency in Brent oil futures generally improves over the examined sample period.
